Saadia-specific moves preserved per data-source/saadia-gloss-table.json; Blau's notes (data-source/blau-genesis-notes.json) consulted for Bereshit 1-12.

translations.1: Then God spoke to Moses, speaking to him directly.
translations.2: See — I have already honored Bezalel son of Uri son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah,
translations.3: and I have made complete in him a knowledge from God: in wisdom, and understanding, and skill in all the crafts —
translations.4: expert in the trades, in the working of gold and silver and copper,
translations.5: and in the cutting of gems for setting, and in the carpentry of wood, and in the making of all the rest of the crafts.
translations.6: And I, for my part, have joined to him Oholiab son of Ahisamakh of the tribe of Dan; and in the heart of every skilled man I have placed wisdom, that they may make all that I have commanded you:
translations.7: the tent of the assembly, and the ark of the testimony, and the cover which is upon it, and all the rest of the vessels of the tent,
translations.8: and the table and its vessels, and the pure lampstand and all its vessels, and the altar of incense,
translations.9: and the altar of the offering and all its vessels, and the laver and its base,
translations.10: and the embroidered garments, and the sacred garments for Aaron the imām, and the garments of his sons for the imāmate,
translations.11: and the anointing oil, and the incense of the resins for the sacred place — according to all that I commanded you, they shall make.
translations.12: And God said to Moses, saying:
translations.13: 'And you — command the sons of Israel and say to them: As for My sabbaths, you shall keep them; for they are a sign between Me and you throughout your generations, that they may know that I am God who sanctifies you.
translations.14: And keep the Sabbath, for it is consecrated to you; and he who profanes it shall surely be put to death — and anyone who performs labor on it, that person shall be cut off from his people.
translations.15: Six days shall the crafts be done, but on the seventh day there is a cessation: it is a Sabbath consecrated to God; whoever performs labor on it shall be put to death.
translations.16: And the sons of Israel shall keep the Sabbath and abide by it throughout their generations — a covenant forever.
translations.17: For it is a sign between Me and the sons of Israel: for in six days God made the heavens and the earth, and on the seventh day He desisted from it and gave it rest.'
translations.18: Then He delivered to Moses — when He had finished speaking with him upon Mount Sinai — the two tablets of the testimony: tablets of stone, written by the power of God.
